claims.claim: Infleqtion reported on September 24 that it achieved its stated 2026 roadmap milestone of 30 entangled logical qubits on Sqale using 80 physical qubits, which reduces the specific execution uncertainty around whether the 30-logical-qubit milestone would be reached on schedule but does not by itself establish economic quantum advantage or scalable customer economics.

The same disclosure says Infleqtion has three customers for logical-qubit circuits and describes an approximately 1000x signal-over-noise experimental confirmation, while explicitly retaining forward-looking risk around commercialization, customer technical requirements, quantum advantage and future scaling targets; therefore the risk question should shift from milestone attainment toward independent reproducibility, workload economics and conversion of technical progress into durable revenue.

risks.risk: Achievement of the 30-logical-qubit milestone does not itself demonstrate customer workload superiority versus classical alternatives or durable commercial economics.
Future 100-logical-qubit and 1,000-logical-qubit targets remain forward-looking and subject to scaling, error-correction, market-acceptance and commercialization risks identified by the issuer.

contradictions.contradiction: A previously forward 30-logical-qubit execution milestone is now reported achieved, while economic quantum advantage and scalable commercial deployment remain unproven.
contradictions.disposition: narrows the technical execution uncertainty; preserve the successor commercialization/economics uncertainty rather than treating the old milestone risk as unchanged

unknowns.unknown: Independent third-party replication or validation of the 30-entangled-logical-qubit result was not established by the reviewed issuer/SEC disclosure.
Revenue contribution, margins and repeatable customer economics attributable specifically to logical-qubit workloads remain Alpha-owned underwriting questions.
